families.note: WENZEL and "No Name" are both printed as born 15 Nov. 1877. The 1867 ship's records list a son Wenzel, age 6 months; the child list has no son of that age, and its WENZEL is born in 1877 ("Wenzel 2" in the 1880 census). Both are kept as printed.

The 1985 book prints "The family of John Kastl and Mary" with six children. The 1986 supplement says John never married and that the family should be "The family of Martin Kastl"; the six children are therefore placed with Martin, and this marriage is kept only as the 1985 reading.

The children are placed here, with Martin, as the supplement says; no mother is named for them.
